name: Imani Nwosu
role: Covert entry and social penetration specialist — infiltrator
location: The Overhang — residential shelves built onto megastructure exteriors, near Kedzie and Division
description:
Imani Nwosu is athletic and fluid, the kind of body that suggests either dancer or fighter — and in GLMZ, the distinction is academic. At 30, she has the kind of face that changes depending on the light — trustworthy in daylight, dangerous after dark. The chrome is visible — neural dampener — blocks external hacking attempts, passive ice in the brain — and she makes no effort to hide it.

She used to be somebody else, in another city, with another name — that person is officially dead, and Imani Nwosu plans to keep it that way. She works as a infiltrator out of The Overhang, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Imani Nwosu is the kind of runner other runners tell stories about, though the stories vary depending on who she burned last.

core_fears: Being captured alive — death is preferable to corporate interrogation
Betrayal by someone they trust — the only currency that matters
Losing control of their own body to a hacker or malfunctioning cyberware
core_desires: Freedom from augmentation debt — the interest compounds like a tumor
The perfect run — one job so clean it becomes legend
Control — over their body, their schedule, their future
coping_mechanisms: Planning — responds to chaos by making detailed contingency plans for everything
Ritual — follows the same pre-job routine every time, superstition as structure
Isolates — retreats into their space when overwhelmed, emerges only for work
blind_spots: Assumes the worst in corporate people, missing the rare ones who could be allies
Cannot see that their independence is actually isolation wearing a better outfit
Trusts technology more than people — machines don't betray
psychology.secret: Cem Padilla-Nti has a terminal condition — geneware degradation — with an estimated five years. They haven't changed their lifestyle. They haven't told anyone.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Flat affect, monotone delivery. The content is terrifying but the voice never rises.
speech_patterns.cadence: Flowing and unhurried — talks like someone who has never been interrupted and doesn't expect to be.
verbal_tics: Hums tunelessly when planning — the team has learned to wait for the humming to stop
Ends statements with 'yeah?' — not a question, a dare
example_lines: "The best disguise is being exactly who they expect to see."
"I was in the building for six hours before anyone realized I didn't work there."
"Security is a story people tell themselves. I'm the plot twist."

story_hooks: A high-paying contract turns out to target someone Cem Padilla-Nti owes a personal debt to
Cem Padilla-Nti intercepts intelligence about a threat to their district and must decide between profit and protection
The fixer who handles Cem Padilla-Nti's contracts goes silent — dead, disappeared, or turned
narrative_function: Cem Padilla-Nti is a pressure point — the kind of character whose choices ripple outward. When she makes a decision, other people's lives change. That weight is the engine of her stories.
augmentations: Neural dampener — blocks external hacking attempts, passive ICE in the brain. Eye replacement — one organic, one cybernetic with recording capability and zoom
daily_life: Wakes early, runs maintenance on gear, checks dead drops and message boards for contracts. Eats when convenient, sleeps when possible. The days between jobs are spent maintaining contacts, updating equipment, and performing the low-grade paranoia that passes for self-care in the runner community.

weaknesses: trust issues that limit crew effectiveness
augmentation dependency — performance drops sharply if chrome malfunctions

decision_rules: Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
Always verifies target identity independently before lethal contracts
Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
escalation_ladder: 1. De-escalate — talk first, assess options, buy time
2. Reposition — move to advantage, control sightlines and exits
3. Threaten — make consequences clear without committing to them
5. Lethal force — only when other options are exhausted or time runs out
6. Scorched earth — everything burns, survival takes priority over everything

interpersonal_modes.employers: Guarded respect. They pay, the job gets done. Anything beyond that is liability.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Competitive but reliable. Will challenge decisions but never abandon the team.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Default suspicion, scaled by context. Everyone is a potential threat until proven otherwise.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Calm escalation. Each response is proportional until it isn't, and the transition is seamless.

stress_responses.low: Heightened awareness, sharper focus. Low stress is fuel.
stress_responses.medium: Becomes curt and demanding. Efficiency overrides courtesy.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Berserker clarity. Everything becomes simple: survive. Deal with the rest later. The simplicity is almost peaceful.

contradictions: Insists they work alone but performs noticeably better in a team
Advocates caution to others but takes insane risks personally — double standard they can't see
Claims to work only for money but regularly takes underpriced jobs that serve personal justice
habits: Practices a kata or fighting form every morning regardless of circumstances
Never drinks anything they didn't see poured or open themselves
Takes a specific route home every time, varying only one block per trip — paranoia as lifestyle
Arrives fifteen minutes early to everything — late once, nearly died, never again
breaking_points: Watching someone they trained or mentored die on a job they recommended
Complete isolation — cut off from network, contacts, and purpose simultaneously
Being forced to harm a civilian — collateral damage that can't be rationalized

physical_description.heritage: Complex global ancestry: 38.6% Sub-Saharan African, 27.3% South Asian, 22.7% Eastern European, 8.2% Hispanic/Latin American, 3.2% East Asian. The combination creates a striking phenotype where African ancestry provides foundational structure and richness, South Asian genetics add warmth and softer contours, Eastern European heritage introduces subtle angularity and cool undertones, with minor Hispanic/Latin American and East Asian elements adding nuanced depth to facial geometry.
physical_description.build: Athletic and lean with defined musculature — dancer's grace married to fighter's tension. No excess, everything functional. Shoulders broad but not bulky, core visibly tight beneath fitted clothing.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown, naturally, but currently dyed a matte charcoal with subtle iridescent underlay that catches light in certain angles
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a tight, low bun — practical, secure, difficult to grab. No loose ends, literally or professionally
physical_description.eye_color: Left eye: warm brown, organic. Right eye: cybernetic with gunmetal iris and faint LED circuitry visible around the pupil, capable of macro zoom and recording
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with golden richness from Sub-Saharan African ancestry, brightened by South Asian warmth, cooled subtly by Eastern European heritage — creates striking luminous depth with complex undertones
physical_description.complexion: High, prominent cheekbones with strength and definition from African ancestry balanced by softer fullness from South Asian genetics, strong defined jawline with subtle angularity from Eastern European heritage, with minor East Asian influence visible in eye structure. Features that read as 'not someone to underestimate.' Skin is clear and well-maintained but bears the tight, hydration-depleted look of someone who runs on coffee and adrenaline. Minimal cosmetics — a small amount of eyeliner around the cybernetic eye to blend the seams.
distinguishing_marks: Thin scar along the left temple, barely visible but present under sharp light — old injury, cleanly healed
Burn scar on the inside of her right forearm, roughly 3cm long, shaped like a power coupling — intentional documentation of a past identity's erasure
Faint tattoo on the inside of her left wrist: a geometric pattern in cipher — unbreakable by outsiders, personal meaning only
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Neural dampener visible as a faint silvery mesh beneath the skin at the back of her skull, most apparent when hair is pulled tight or in direct light. The cybernetic right eye is partially visible as matte gunmetal with geometric etching around the socket. Both are deliberately left unhidden — a statement.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with predatory efficiency — no wasted motion, every step deliberate. Stands with weight balanced for instant movement in any direction. Eyes are always tracking, always assessing. When sitting, she occupies minimal space but maintains constant awareness of exits. Speaks quietly; people lean in to hear her.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3 functional — form-fitting matte black synthetic bodysuit as base layer, sealed at wrists and ankles. Worn beneath a fitted charcoal grey tactical coat with secure pockets and smart-fabric seams that can bypass basic scans. Boots are military-grade, black, laced tight, soles reinforced for silent movement. No jewelry except a worn steel watch with encrypted timekeeping. Everything is matte-finished to reduce reflectivity. No logos, no branded affiliation. Clothing is selected for function: silent, durable, forgettable.

Left eye warm organic brown, right eye matte gunmetal cybernetic with LED circuitry and geometric etching. Charcoal hair pulled tight in low bun with iridescent underlay.
